judgment.notes: A001: the displayed coordinate bases establish finite-dimensional real normed spaces of ranks n₀ and n₀+1, so M007 gives the stated full-space dimensions. A002: E and F lie in those respective ambient spaces, giving both upper bounds by M006. A003: ℝ has rank one and 1/2 is an interior point of I, satisfying M013. A004: F003 establishes the isometry ℝ→MaxProd(Rn(n₀)); its distance equality also preserves extended distances, so M008 applies to I. A005: the image inclusion in F003 supplies exactly M006's subset hypothesis. These applications require no measurability of E or F. There are no E applications or direct N bridges.

Coordinate expansion and coordinatewise uniqueness prove the two basis claims, including the empty coordinate basis when n₀=0. S001 obtains finite upper bounds and nonnegativity; S002 proves dimH(I)=1 using an actual interior witness. S003 computes the fiber-map distances and proves its image inclusion. S004 combines isometry invariance and monotonicity to obtain 1≤T. Finite upper bounds justify all real representatives and finite addition/order identifications. No limit, regularity assertion or unproved dimension-product formula is used.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
